record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Nehiloth<WH05155>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> to my words<WH0561>, O LORD<WH03068>, consider<WH0995><WTH8798> my meditation<WH01901>.
Hearken<WH07181><WTH8685> unto the voice<WH06963> of my cry<WH07773>, my King<WH04428>, and my God<WH0430>: for unto thee will I pray<WH06419><WTH8691>.

My voice<WH06963> shalt thou hear<WH08085><WTH8799> in the morning<WH01242>, O LORD<WH03068>; in the morning<WH01242> will I direct<WH06186><WTH8799> <FI>my prayer<Fi> unto thee, and will look up<WH06822><WTH8762>.
For thou <FI>art<Fi> not a God<WH0410> that hath pleasure<WH02655> in wickedness<WH07562>: neither shall evil<WH07451> dwell<WH01481><WTH8799> with thee.

The foolish<WH01984><WTH8802> shall not stand<WH03320><WTH8691> in thy sight<WH05869>: thou hatest<WH08130><WTH8804> all workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205>. <RF>in...: Heb. before thine eyes<Rf>

Thou shalt destroy<WH06><WTH8762> them that speak<WH01696><WTH8802> leasing<WH03577>: the LORD<WH03068> will abhor<WH08581><WTH8762> the bloody<WH01818> and deceitful<WH04820> man<WH0376>. <RF>bloody...: Heb. man of bloods and deceit<Rf><CM>

But as for me, I will come<WH0935><WTH8799> <FI>into<Fi> thy house<WH01004> in the multitude<WH07230> of thy mercy<WH02617>: <FI>and<Fi> in thy fear<WH03374> will I worship<WH07812><WTH8691> toward thy holy<WH06944> temple<WH01964>. <RF>thy holy...: Heb. the temple of thy holiness<Rf>

Lead<WH05148><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068>, in thy righteousness<WH06666> because of mine enemies<WH08324><WTH8802>; make thy way<WH01870> straight<WH03474><WTH8685> before my face<WH06440>. <RF>mine...: Heb. those which observe me<Rf>

For <FI>there is<Fi> no faithfulness<WH03559><WTH8737> in their mouth<WH06310>; their inward<WH07130> part <FI>is<Fi> very wickedness<WH01942>; their throat<WH01627> <FI>is<Fi> an open<WH06605><WTH8803> sepulchre<WH06913>; they flatter<WH02505><WTH8686> with their tongue<WH03956>. <RF>faithfulness: or, stedfastness<Rf> <RF>their mouth: Heb. his mouth, that is, the mouth of any of them<Rf> <RF>very...: Heb. wickednesses<Rf>

Destroy<WH0816><WTH8685> thou them, O God<WH0430>; let them fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by their own counsels<WH04156>; cast them out<WH05080><WTH8685> in the multitude<WH07230> of their transgressions<WH06588>; for they have rebelled<WH04784><WTH8804> against thee. <RF>Destroy...: or, Make them guilty<Rf> <RF>by...: or, from their counsels<Rf>

But let all those that put their trust<WH02620><WTH8802> in thee rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799>: let them ever<WH05769> shout for joy<WH07442><WTH8762>, because thou defendest<WH05526><WTH8686> them: let them also that love<WH0157><WTH8802> thy name<WH08034> be joyful<WH05970><WTH8799> in thee. <RF>defendest...: Heb. coverest over, or, protectest them<Rf>

For thou, LORD<WH03068>, wilt bless<WH01288><WTH8762> the righteous<WH06662>; with favour<WH07522> wilt thou compass<WH05849><WTH8799> him as <FI>with<Fi> a shield<WH06793>. <RF>compass: Heb. crown<Rf><CM>
